unverified_summary: Pro Game Guides and Destructoid agree on five currently listed codes, but Pocket Tactics reports smaller bundles for StarShower and OmegaCode and still lists GrandBlueCode as active. An older community wiki report also disagreed about RollWithIt. No Freetins redemption is recorded, so these differences remain attributed rather than presented as confirmed results.
